subject: Game Theory
title: Money as Trust
description: A quick win: understand Money as Trust.

hook.text: A dollar bill is just paper. It works because everyone trusts that everyone else will accept it as payment.

buildup.text: Money solves a coordination problem: without it, a baker who wants shoes must find a cobbler who wants bread.

discovery.text: This 'double coincidence of wants' problem vanishes when everyone accepts a common token. Money is trust made portable.

twist.text: Hyperinflation destroys this trust. In 2008 Zimbabwe, people used eggs as currency because dollars were worthless.

climax.text: Bitcoin tried to replace institutional trust with math. Its volatility showed trust can't be fully automated.

punchline.text: Money works because we all agree it does.
